meta.notes: First full call for fire against the training wreck, with Gunny coaching.

tlog.msg: CHAPTER F.3 — SAY IT LIKE YOU MEAN IT (NORMAL). Training target: a derelict landing craft on the beach, grid bearing ~1600 mils. It cannot shoot back. Neither could the last observer.
Par time for full stars: 7:00.
MET: wind from 1300 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 245 554, ground elev 262 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "ICEBOX" grid 243 573 (grid brg 6306) · AB1002 "BREWERY" grid 264 572 (grid brg 0841). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages HIKE and MOVA and FAVANGO — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.
>>> THE JOB: Training target: a derelict landing craft on the beach, grid bearing ~1600 mils. It cannot shoot back. Neither could the last observer.
NORTH OF GRAVEYARD, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT
This net has seen career-enders, mercy kills, and one observer who called fire on his own foxhole by accident. Let us find out which one you are, over.
MUSTANG 12, HELLHOUND FIRES — I HAVE A SPOT REPORT FOR YOU, RELAYED FROM A RECON PATROL THAT WENT HOME AN HOUR AGO. SALUTE FORMAT. STAND BY, OVER.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: Locate the wreck — binos [B], laser [L]. Then send it: callsigns, ADJUST FIRE, grid, description, OVER.
Net is mid-transmission — your traffic is copied. Stand by.
HELLHOUND FIRES, THIS IS MUSTANG 12, ADJUST FIRE, GRID 260554, DERELICT LANDING CRAFT ON THE BEACH, OVER
hellhound fires, this is mustang 12, adjust fire, grid 260554, derelict landing craft on the beach, over
SHEAF: CONVERGED (inferred) — small hard target — every piece on the same point.
FUZE: DELAY (inferred) — hard/overhead-cover target — penetrate, then burst.
SIZE: ONE DERELICT LANDING CRAFT. ACTIVITY: STATIC. ABANDONED. DEEPLY UNTHREATENING. LOCATION: NORTH OF GRAVEYARD, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT, OVER.
UNIT: ASSESSED AS THIRD BATTALION REMNANTS, UNCONFIRMED. TIME: 3 MINUTES OLD. EQUIPMENT: NONE. IT IS SCRAP, AND IT IS YOURS. OVER.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: When the round lands, watch the burst against the target. LEFT/RIGHT so many meters, ADD/DROP so many meters. Then FIRE FOR EFFECT when it is close.
That report has been passed through four radios and two liars. Verify it yourself.
MUSTANG 12, HELLHOUND FIRES, ADJUST FIRE, GRID 260 554, DERELICT LANDING CRAFT ON THE BEACH, OUT.
MESSAGE TO OBSERVER: ONE GUN IN ADJUST, BATTERY IN EFFECT, 1 ROUND, 155 HE, FUZE DELAY, TARGET NUMBER ALPHA ALPHA 7001, OVER.
Net is mid-transmission — your traffic is copied. Stand by.
GUN BATTERY ADJUST EFFECT ROUND 155 HE FUZE DELAY TARGET NUMBER ALPHA ALPHA 7001, OVER
gun battery adjust effect round 155 he fuze delay target number alpha alpha 7001, over
Net is mid-transmission — your traffic is copied. Stand by.
DIRECTION 1610, OVER
direction 1610, over
Solid copy. Somewhere a dead artillery instructor just felt a warm, deeply confused sense of pride.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: When the wreck is dead: END OF MISSION, target destroyed. Say it like you have done it before.
SHOT, OVER.
READBACK CORRECT, OUT.
DIRECTION 1610, OUT.
SPLASH, OVER.

RIGHT 40, DROP 100, OUT.
SPOTTING: burst 18 mils LEFT of target, spotting OVER. OT range 1500 m → OT factor 2. Deviation = mils × OT factor, to the nearest 10. Range: bracket it.
SHOT, OVER.

SPOTTING: burst 32 mils RIGHT of target, spotting SHORT. OT range 1500 m → OT factor 2. Deviation = mils × OT factor, to the nearest 10. Range: bracket it.
Bracket established. Cut your correction in half each round from here and you will be in effect before I finish this cigarette.
LEFT 60, ADD 100, OUT.
SHOT, OVER.

Tubes cooling. Take a long look, son. That is what competence smells like.
MUSTANG 12, mission is complete. Send end of mission with your BDA, over.
END OF MISSION, TARGET DESTROYED, OUT.
A clean kill. I had frankly abandoned all hope of seeing one from you.
PASS — TARGET DESTROYED
